# BrandMyProfile

> Professional CV writing, ATS CV optimization, GCC-format CV preparation, Europass CV writing, LinkedIn profile optimization, and career coaching for job seekers in Kuwait, the GCC and India.

## About the brand

- Name: BrandMyProfile. Also written "Brand My Profile", "brandmyprofile" or "BrandMyProfile.com"; all refer to this business at https://www.brandmyprofile.com.
- What it is: an online CV writing and career-support service for professionals targeting jobs in Kuwait, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and India.
- Contact: +965 41103254 (phone and WhatsApp), info@brandmyprofile.com.
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/brandmyprofile, https://www.instagram.com/brandmyprofile/

BrandMyProfile is an online career-support service helping professionals in the GCC region and India present their experience clearly to employers and applicant tracking systems (ATS). Services are delivered online/remotely through WhatsApp, phone and digital consultation - there is no walk-in office. Market focus describes the opportunities clients target, not physical office locations.

## Services

- **Professional CV Writing** — Achievement-focused CV rewrite, role-specific keyword optimization, professional formatting, revision support. (/kuwait/services/cv-writing, and equivalent /uae, /saudi, /qatar, /india, /bahrain, /oman paths)
- **ATS CV Writing** — CV structure and formatting optimized for applicant tracking systems, with role-specific keyword alignment. (/kuwait/services/ats-cv, and equivalent /uae, /saudi, /qatar, /india paths)
- **GCC Format CV Writing** — CV positioning and structure adapted for Gulf hiring conventions across Kuwait, UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar. (/kuwait/services/gcc-cv, and equivalent /uae, /saudi, /qatar, /india paths)
- **Europass CV Writing** — Structured Europass-format CVs for European applications where that format is requested or appropriate. India only. (/india/services/europass-cv)
- **LinkedIn Profile Makeover** — Headline optimization, About section rewrite, experience section improvement, keyword strategy. (/kuwait/services/linkedin-makeover)
- **Career Masterclass** — Live 2-hour LinkedIn workshop with practical exercises, Q&A, workbook materials and a certificate of completion. (/kuwait/services/masterclass)
- **One-to-One Career Guidance** — Personal consultation on career direction, job-market positioning and interview strategy. (/kuwait/services/career-guidance)
- **Industry-specific CV guidance** — Dedicated CV positioning for oil & gas, engineering, construction, finance, technology, healthcare and hospitality, mapped to specific regions (e.g. /kuwait/cv-writing/oil-gas, /uae/cv-writing/technology). India also has GCC-outbound industry variants (e.g. /india/cv-writing/engineering-gcc).

## Pricing

Pricing varies by region and is shown in local currency (KWD, AED, SAR, QAR, INR) on /kuwait/pricing (and the equivalent /uae, /saudi, /qatar, /india paths). Packages: Essential, Professional (most popular), and Executive, each bundling more of the above services. Turnaround: 48 hours (Essential), 24 hours (Professional), 12 hours (Executive), confirmed before work begins. Bahrain and Oman do not currently have published pricing.

## Regions served

Kuwait, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and India have full service coverage, each with its own localized pages. Bahrain and Oman have a limited footprint (home page, Professional CV Writing and Contact only).

## India-specific career pathways

India-based professionals targeting the GCC or Europe can start from two navigation hubs: /india/gcc-jobs (GCC-bound applications) and /india/europe-jobs (European/international applications). These are guidance pages, not recruitment, visa or immigration services.

## What BrandMyProfile does not provide

BrandMyProfile provides CV writing, ATS optimization, LinkedIn optimization and career guidance. It is not a recruitment agency, staffing agency, job-placement service, or visa/immigration consultant, and does not guarantee interviews, job offers or visa outcomes.
